subcategory_text: Privacy values, policies, and training are reviewed and any updates are communicated.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-1 (Information Security Program Plan), AT-2 (Awareness Training)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.1, A.5.35 (Independent review of information security)
implementation_examples: Review privacy values, policies, and training for continued appropriateness and update them in response to changes (regulatory, business, technical)
Communicate updates through the same channels as the original publication (intranet, public web, training)
Track version changes and acknowledgements where required
assessment_objectives: Determine whether privacy values, policies, and training are reviewed periodically
Determine whether updates are communicated to stakeholders
Determine whether the review covers regulatory, business, and technical change drivers
Determine whether version history is preserved
